items.title: OECD says growth 'resilient' in 2026 despite Middle East war
items.description: The OECD group of industrialized nations put its 2026 growth forecast at 2.9%. It said investment in AI was helping drive growth, while the war in the Middle East was fueling inflation.

items.title: Hungary: EU Commission wants to unblock €4.2b in funding
items.description: The Commission's president has argued that Budapest is strengthening the rule of law with Viktor Orban finally out of office. Funds had been blocked over corruption allegations under Hungary's former government.

items.title: As the EU advances free trade with Southeast Asia, why is there no ASEAN-wide deal?
items.description: After years of arduous negotiations, the EU is closing on a string of bilateral trade deals with countries in Southeast Asia. And yet, a bloc-to-bloc agreement between the EU and ASEAN remains a distant prospect.
